'''Hex Metoni''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Metoni held the rank of [[Major/Legends|major]] and was spotted flying a [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighter]] in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]].<ref name="SWG:Cs" />
{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:RebelPilotTemplate.jpg|200px|thumb|Possible depictions of Major Hex Metoni]]
Hex Metoni appeared aboard their [[Starship/Legends|starship]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:Cs" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Major Hex Metoni was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]]. Hex Metoni appeared in the game as a starfighter boss that had a low probability to spawn among a group of Rebel starfighters in the Corellian system.<ref name="SWG:Cs" />
